question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
WITH first_term AS (
  SELECT 
    lt.id_bioguide,
    MIN(CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)) AS first_term_start
  FROM legislators_terms lt
  WHERE lt.state = 'LA'
  GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide
),
male_la_legislators AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l.id_bioguide,
    l.full_name,
    l.gender,
    ft.first_term_start
  FROM legislators l
  JOIN first_term ft ON l.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
  WHERE l.gender = 'M'
)
SELECT 
  CAST((DATE('2023-12-31') - ml.first_term_start) AS INTEGER) / 365 AS years_elapsed,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ml.id_bioguide) AS distinct_legislators
FROM male_la_legislators ml
WHERE CAST((DATE('2023-12-31') - ml.first_term_start) AS INTEGER) / 365 > 30 
  AND CAST((DATE('2023-12-31') - ml.first_term_start) AS INTEGER) / 365 < 50
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed
